backgroundPermissionRationale.title: StillHere needs background location
backgroundPermissionRationale.message: StillHere monitors your safety even when the app is in the background. This ensures your emergency contacts can locate you if needed.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: StillHere uses your location to monitor your safety, share your position with emergency contacts, and send alerts if you need help.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: StillHere uses your location to show your position on the map and share it with your emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: StillHere needs continuous location access to monitor your safety in the background, detect emergencies, and keep your emergency contacts informed.
